If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Prahran (VIC 3181)**, there are several locksmiths in and around the area that install and configure digital and smart locks.

Some well-reviewed options include:

- ASAP Locksmiths Melbourne – Based in Windsor, offers lock installation and security upgrades.
- Prahran Locksmith Services – 24/7 mobile locksmith servicing Prahran.
- Magen Locksmiths – Installs and programs digital and smart locks.
- LockCorp Locksmiths – 24/7 locksmith with experience in electronic lock installations.
- Superior Tech Locksmiths – Specialises in lock replacement and smart lock fitting.

Many Melbourne locksmiths also install brands such as Yale, Lockly, Samsung, Schlage, Aqara, and other keyless entry systems, and can usually:
- Replace an existing deadbolt with a smart lock.
- Install a new smart lock on compatible timber or metal doors.
- Set up PIN codes, fingerprints, mobile apps, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity.
- Check door compatibility before installation. [www.newgenlocksmith.com.au](https://www.newgenlocksmith.com.au/services/smart-lock-installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Typical installation pricing is often around **A$150–A$350** for labour, depending on the door, lock type, and whether you're supplying the lock yourself. If the locksmith also supplies the lock, they'll usually provide a bundled quote. [www.newgenlocksmith.com.au](https://www.newgenlocksmith.com.au/services/smart-lock-installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
